\caption{Welfare comparison across different closures in the closure matrix.
The variables reported in each cell are welfare estimates of an identical
allocation, all in percent against the reference continuation. $W_C$ is the
household-consumption index of Table~\ref{tab:results-matrix}; $W_D$ the
quantity index of demand, i.e.\ the own-weights aggregate over $c+g$;
$W_{CES}$ the CES evaluation of that bundle at the \emph{baseline}
preference weights; $W_{CES^*}$ the same bundle evaluated at the
\emph{adopted} weights; and $W^{L}$ the first-order leisure-augmented form,
which also charges the household for the additional work a program requires.}
